attempts.sql: WITH py_files AS (SELECT file_id, line_count, regexp_extract(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/([^/]+)/', 1) AS subfolder FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND file_id LIKE '%.py') SELECT 'auto_ontology/server/' || subfolder AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM py_files WHERE subfolder <> '' GROUP BY subfolder HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY folder_path
